## Classification

Every story declares its `Type`; the declared type is used as-is.

| Story | Declared type | Secondary type | Why the secondary matters |
|---|---|---|---|
| story-145 Đất và camera (#145) | Integration | Logic | camera bounds and tile picking are computable and must be unit-tested |
| story-146 Trạm, đồ, thỏ dựng đứng (#146) | Visual/Feel | Logic | the criterion itself asks for an EditMode test of prefabs, feet on the ground and the scale table |
| story-147 Ánh sáng và bóng (#147) | Visual/Feel | Logic | "đổi giờ không đổi số cà rốt" is a Core guarantee |
| story-148 Hậu kỳ, trời, HUD (#148) | UI | Integration | HUD, sheets and photo mode must keep working on a new camera stack |
| story-149 Hiệu năng mobile (#149) | Integration | Config/Data | quality tiers and renderer settings are data; fps is a measurement |

Gaps found while planning (not blockers for the plan):
- No TR-IDs yet (`docs/architecture/tr-registry.yaml` not built); traceability is to issue numbers.
- `docs/architecture/control-manifest.md` does not exist; forbidden patterns come from `CLAUDE.md` and `tools/conventions.py`.
- The GDD has no 2.5D formulas. Camera FOV ~25°, tilt ~40°, the scale table and the light colours live only in the stories and `docs/de-xuat-2-5d.md`. Tests must take those numbers from one constants place, not repeat them.
- The only GDD formula the 2.5D work must keep is the scene mapping `x = 150 (q + r / 2)`, `y = −200 r` (`GardenGrid.PitchX/PitchY`) and the tile distance `max(|q|, |r|, |q + r|)`.

## Automated Tests Required

### story-145 Đất và camera — Integration
**Test file path**: `Assets/Tests/EditMode/` (name chosen by `/dev-story`; suggested `GroundCameraTests.cs`)
**What to test**:
- Camera stays inside the island bounds at every zoom level (story AC-1): drag to the four corners at minimum and maximum zoom, the view centre stays inside the island's bounding box.
- Tile picking via `PhysicsRaycaster` + `IPointerClickHandler` (AC-2): a click at the screen position of an empty tile and of a station hits exactly that tile/station; the world position of a tile follows `GardenGrid` (`x = 150 (q + r / 2)`, `y = −200 r`, mapped onto the ground plane).
- Map screen (#91) through an orthographic camera and `RenderTexture` (AC-3): texture not null, sized to the screen, still valid after opening the map twice.
- Camera is fixed perspective, FOV ~25°, tilt ~40°, never rotates (read from the constants, not repeated in the test).
- Locked land has no mist object; the 2.5D garden keeps `Motion.Reduced`, large text and vi/en working (re-run `AccessibilityTests`, `MapViewScreenTests`).

**Edge cases to cover**:
- A newly opened segment enlarges the bounds (from 0 to 6 segments).
- A tile on the island edge at minimum zoom; a station whose default tile is taken (GDD §5 `NearestEmptyApart`).
- No raycast in `Update()`: `tools/conventions.py` per-frame-update count does not rise.

**Estimated test count**: ~8 EditMode tests

### story-146 Dựng đứng billboard — Visual/Feel (Logic part)
**Test file path**: `Assets/Tests/EditMode/` (suggested `BillboardScaleTests.cs`)
**What to test**:
- Every station, prop, tree, lamp and rabbit has a prefab; pivot at the feet; the feet touch the ground at the `GardenGrid` tile position.
- Scale table, rabbit = 1, ±15 %: station 0.8–1.3, counter 1.8–2.2, lamp post 1.4, fish tank 0.9, mortar 0.7, tree 2.5–3.5.
- Billboards rotate only around the vertical axis (no tilt toward the camera).
- World Space labels keep the three tiers and zoom thresholds of #135: ≤ 4 text labels at default zoom, no two overlapping, text ≥ 22 units at default zoom.
- The three sample stations' 4-beat work loops use Animator clips and `SpriteResolver`, no motion maths (`conventions.py` procedural-animation count does not rise).

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Full garden (16 stations, 6 segments) at minimum and maximum zoom.
- Large text on: labels still within the ≤ 4 count and not overlapping.
- A station placed on an edge tile and a stored station (not drawn).

**Estimated test count**: ~6 EditMode tests

### story-147 Ánh sáng và bóng — Visual/Feel (Logic part)
**Test file path**: existing Core tests (`Assets/Tests/EditMode/`, run by `tools/ci/core-tests.sh`)
**What to test**:
- Changing the time of day (`Daylight`) does not change any carrot number; the existing Core and Slow simulation tests stay green unchanged.
- One directional "moon" light casts shadows; lanterns are point lights without shadows (a scene-setup EditMode check).

**Edge cases to cover**: dawn and dusk boundaries of `Daylight`; rain on at night.

**Estimated test count**: ~2 new EditMode checks; all existing Core tests unchanged

### story-148 Hậu kỳ và HUD — UI (Integration part)
**Test file path**: `Assets/Tests/EditMode/` (extend `AccessibilityTests`, `GardenScreenTests`)
**What to test**:
- HUD, tab bar, sheets, cards and photo mode open and close on the 2.5D camera stack (UI camera or Screen Space Overlay).
- At most 2 full-screen overlays active with a sheet open (story AC-1); the uGUI `PaperGrain` layer is gone and the grain is one Renderer Feature pass.
- Large text and vi/en: the existing spill, touch-size and contrast sweeps stay green on the new scene.
- HUD and tab bar never cover more than half of a rabbit at default zoom (story AC-2).

**Edge cases to cover**: photo mode with large text; a sheet open over the map screen.

**Estimated test count**: ~5 EditMode tests plus the existing accessibility sweeps

### story-149 Hiệu năng mobile — Integration
**Test file path**: `Assets/Tests/EditMode/` (suggested `QualityTierTests.cs`; keep `AllocationTests`)
**What to test**:
- SRP Batcher on; one shadow-casting light (the moon); short shadow distance.
- The low quality tier turns bloom off and reduces shadows; the high tier keeps them.
- Billboards share an atlas and a small set of materials (count materials in the full-garden scene).
- `AllocationTests.A_Full_Garden_With_Every_Round_Two_Feature_Stands_Still_Without_Allocating` stays at 0 allocations on the 2.5D scene.

**Edge cases to cover**: rain and fireflies on together in the fullest garden (story AC-1 edge case).

**Estimated test count**: ~4 EditMode tests + the existing allocation tests

## Manual QA Checklist

Note for every manual check: QA D cannot send taps to the Mac build (macOS Accessibility is not granted to the QA tool), so the hand checks below are done by the owner or B on the Mac/iPhone, or replaced by screen tests where a test can reach the same state.

### story-145 Đất và camera — Integration
**Verification method**: before/after frames + hand check of drag and pinch
**Who must sign off**: design session (visual-critic-gate), owner for feel
**Evidence to capture**: `docs/anh/po-145/` frames at default zoom 1080×1920, vi/en, large text
- [ ] Island with a thick soil edge; camera tilted ~40°, never rotates
- [ ] Locked land is one step darker grass with a low fence and a wooden sign, no mist
- [ ] Drag has inertia and stops softly at the island edge; pinch zoom works
- [ ] Tapping a station opens its card; tapping an empty tile does not open a neighbour
- [ ] Map screen shows the top-down view
- [ ] No single straight path column; visual-critic-gate APPROVED

### story-146 Dựng đứng billboard — Visual/Feel
**Verification method**: screenshot + visual-critic-gate + designer sign-off
**Who must sign off**: design session (art direction)
**Evidence to capture**: garden frame and a zoomed station frame, before/after, in `docs/anh/po-146/`; one GIF per sample station (trà sữa, hái chè, pha trà); 25 % grey version
- [ ] Every object stands upright with its feet on the ground, facing the camera
- [ ] Sizes read right against the rabbit (counter about twice, mortar smaller than a rabbit, fish tank not tiny)
- [ ] In the 25 % grey version the rabbit at a station is the brightest spot
- [ ] Each sample station shows a 4-beat work loop that loops cleanly
- [ ] visual-critic-gate APPROVED for the frames and each GIF

### story-147 Ánh sáng và bóng — Visual/Feel
**Verification method**: screenshot + visual-critic-gate + designer sign-off
**Who must sign off**: design session (art direction)
**Evidence to capture**: night, dawn and dusk frames before/after in `docs/anh/po-147/`; one comparison sheet sprite-shadow vs ellipse quad
- [ ] Every shadow points the same way (upper-left light, shadows down-right); shadow colour is tinted `Night`, not #000
- [ ] Lanterns `#FFC866`, ~3 m reach, a warm pool visible on the grass itself
- [ ] The shadow-technique choice is recorded with the comparison sheet
- [ ] visual-critic-gate APPROVED

### story-148 Hậu kỳ và HUD — UI
**Verification method**: retained screenshots of each screen touched
**Who must sign off**: none required for UI (screenshots close it); design session reviews
**Evidence to capture**: garden with HUD, a sheet open, photo mode — vi and en, large text — in `docs/anh/po-148/`
- [ ] No large empty sky above the island (forest, moon, stars or far hills)
- [ ] HUD and tab bar do not cover rabbits or stations at default zoom
- [ ] Bloom only on lamps; vignette subtle; paper grain visible but light
- [ ] Photo mode frame looks like the 2D one in layout

### story-149 Hiệu năng mobile — Integration
**Verification method**: measurement + low-tier frame
**Who must sign off**: owner (target devices), B records the numbers
**Evidence to capture**: fps table in `docs/bao-cao-po.md` (method, device or Editor profile with its conversion), low-tier frame + visual-critic-gate
- [ ] Fullest garden (6 segments, 16 stations, every seat taken), drag and zoom for 60 s: average ≥ 60 fps, lowest ≥ 45, on iPhone 11 and Snapdragon 665, or the Editor profile with the conversion written down
- [ ] Rain and fireflies on together in that run
- [ ] Low tier still reads as the same game (visual-critic-gate APPROVED)

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before QA hand-off of any 2.5D story (run with `/smoke-check sprint` after implementation, not now):

1. Game opens to the title and into the garden without an exception in `Player.log`
2. Continue an existing save: stations, rabbits, decorations, storage and new-moon count all present (`GardenGridTests` save round-trip tests stay green)
3. Drag, pinch, tap a station, open its card and upgrade once
4. Layout mode: lift a station, drop on an empty tile, drop beside another station (springs back), store and take out (`LayoutModeTests`)
5. Map screen (#91) opens and closes
6. Sheets (Quests, Rabbits, Shop) and photo mode open over the 2.5D scene
7. Away screen after a gap; the moon-pass cap line unchanged
8. Large text and reduced motion on: nothing spills or moves (`AccessibilityTests` round-1 and round-2 sweeps)
9. Full garden standing still allocates 0 bytes per frame (`AllocationTests`)
10. `tools/ci/core-tests.sh` green and the Slow simulations unchanged (`GardenPacingTests`, `EconomySimulationTests`) — the 2.5D work must not move any number
11. `python3 -I tools/conventions.py` ok; baseline not raised
12. Player save untouched by the test run (`verify.sh` step "save")

Regression risk from this sprint: everything that reads tile positions or screen positions — Layout mode, decorations, edge pills (#120), world labels (#135), intro "Try it" camera flights (#104/#122), rabbit strolls and breaks (#127), first-session timing (#115).

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result or documented manual evidence
- [ ] Test file exists in `Assets/Tests/EditMode/` for the Integration stories (145, 149) and for the Logic parts of 146–148
- [ ] Retained screenshots of each screen touched for the Visual/Feel (146, 147) and UI (148) stories, in `docs/anh/po-NNN/` (the project's evidence folder; `production/qa/evidence/` is not used yet)
- [ ] visual-critic-gate verdict APPROVED recorded for every Visual/Feel story (146, 147) and for the frames of 145 and 149
- [ ] Smoke check passes (`/smoke-check sprint`) before QA hand-off
- [ ] No regressions: Core tests, Slow simulations, accessibility sweeps, allocation tests and save round-trips stay green
- [ ] Code reviewed (`/code-review`) and `tools/conventions.py` baseline not raised
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`) and the GitHub issue closed by QA acceptance
